title: kissed and gooey uruguayan lamb bake
description: a post-workout dish that combines flavors of light brown soft sugar, uruguayan lamb, and buddhist-temple-friendly ingredients, finished with a flambe sauce. this recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner or a special occasion.
instructions: season the lamb leg with salt and pepper, and dust with flour for dusting.

heat 1 tablespoon of butter in an oven-safe skillet over medium heat. sear the lamb leg until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast for 20 minutes, or until the lamb is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
while the lamb is cooking, mix the light brown soft sugar, brown sugar, flour, eggs, dried oregano, and dried thyme in a bowl until well combined.
remove the skillet from the oven and brush the sugar mixture evenly over the lamb leg.
return the skillet to the oven and continue roasting for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the sugar is caramelized and the lamb is cooked through.
remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
reduce the flambe sauce in a saucepan over medium heat until it has thickened slightly, about 5 minutes. brush the flambe sauce over the lamb leg and serve hot.
meanwhile, serve the remaining sugar mixture as a side dish, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
straddle the lamb leg on a serving platter and present to your guests.
flambé the dish by igniting the flambe sauce with a match or lighter, and then extinguish the flames with a spoon.
serve the lamb hot, garnished with fresh herbs and a side of the sugar mixture.
serve the dish with a side of roasted vegetables, if desired.
